sources: A Curio Class game, made outside this repository and brought in 2026-11-22 (first called Resonance, named Ripple in chat on 2026-11-22). TypeScript source in source/; src.html is its single-file build.
Every instrument, drum and the room echo are synthesized in the browser; no samples, image or font files
MP3 saving was taken out when it came in (its encoder was an LGPL library run from a string); WAV, video and parts saving stay
